items.title: Jerome Richardson interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 9, 1996
items.q: It might be Peter Washington, who is very fine.

ctx.x: Who do you hope to use on this upcoming record?

Lewis Nash, Russell — what’s his name — Monroe, plays guitar. And who else? The bass player — oh, I don’t know. We haven’t decided on a bass player yet because it was George Mraz and I heard George Mraz had some difficulty about the date. It might be Peter Washington, who is very fine. And we haven’t settled it yet.
Well I look forward to it. I hope it goes well for you. Is there any dates, you know, I don’t know if the students have any idea what it might be like to get a call to do a session,
